      • containsArrayRef

        boolean containsArrayRef()
        Returns true if and only if an array reference is used in the statement. In case of Jimple, this might only happen on the left- or the right hand side of an assignment.
        Returns:
        the invoke expression box

      • getArrayRef

        ArrayRef getArrayRef()
              throws RuntimeException
        Returns the array reference of this statement. In case of Jimple, this might only happen on the left- or the right hand side of an assignment. Therefore, this array reference is unique per statement. This method throws an exception if there is no array reference.
        Returns:
        the array reference
        Throws:
        RuntimeException - if there is no array reference
        See Also:
        containsArrayRef(), getArrayRefUnsafe()

      • getArrayRefUnsafe

        ArrayRef getArrayRefUnsafe()
        Returns the array reference of this statement or null. In case of Jimple, this might only happen on the left- or the right hand side of an assignment. Therefore, this array reference is unique per statement.
        Returns:
        the array reference or null

      • getArrayRefBox

        ValueBox getArrayRefBox()
                 throws RuntimeException
        Returns the array reference box of this statement, which is an indirection on the array reference. In case of Jimple, this might only happen on the left- or the right hand side of an assignment. Therefore, this array reference is unique per statement. Throws an exception if there is no array reference expression.
        Returns:
        the array reference box
        Throws:
        RuntimeException - if there is no array reference

      • containsFieldRef

        boolean containsFieldRef()
        Returns true if this Jimple statement has a field reference. Note that this might be a static or instance field. In Jimple, there can only be one field reference per statement, and only part of an assignment. Depending on the location of the field reference (left or right hand side), the field is read or written, respectively.
        Returns:
        true if there is an field reference

      • getFieldRef

        FieldRef getFieldRef()
              throws RuntimeException
        Returns the field reference of this statement. If there is no field reference, the method throws an exception. Note that this might be a static or instance field. In Jimple, there can only be one field reference per statement, and only part of an assignment. Depending on the location of the field reference (left or right hand side), the field is read or written, respectively.
        Returns:
        the field reference
        Throws:
        RuntimeException - if there is no field reference
        See Also:
        containsFieldRef(), getFieldRefUnsafe()

      • getFieldRefUnsafe

        FieldRef getFieldRefUnsafe()
        Returns the field reference of this statement. If there is no field reference, the method returns null. Note that this might be a static or instance field. In Jimple, there can only be one field reference per statement, and only part of an assignment. Depending on the location of the field reference (left or right hand side), the field is read or written, respectively.
        Returns:
        the field reference or null
        Throws:
        RuntimeException - if there is no field reference

      • getFieldRefBox

        ValueBox getFieldRefBox()
                 throws RuntimeException
        Returns the field reference box of this statement, which is an indirection on the field reference. If there is no field reference, the method returns null. Note that this might be a static or instance field. In Jimple, there can only be one field reference per statement, and only part of an assignment. Depending on the location of the field reference (left or right hand side), the field is read or written, respectively.
        Returns:
        the field reference box
        Throws:
        RuntimeException - if there is no field reference
        See Also:
        ValueBox
